name: tnt-llm
title: Build an intent taxonomy from support chats, one minibatch at a time

origin.source: LangGraph TNT-LLM tutorial (taxonomy generation, Wan et al. 2024)

comparison.purpose: Summarizes each sample support chat in its own spawned request, splits the summaries into minibatches, drafts an intent taxonomy from the first batch, refines it against each later batch, and reviews it once. The batch index in context drives the loop through a choice state, MAX_BATCHES is checked before any taxonomy call, a failed summarizer leaves a placeholder instead of stalling the join, and the taxonomy is capped at MAX_CATEGORIES by a choice state instead of by the prompt alone.

starters.label: Three batches of 4 — generate, update twice, review
One batch of 12 — generate, then review
Batch size 1 — generate, eleven updates, review
